name: Med spa: email went unanswered, DM reply asks about price
reference_snapshot: We emailed in September with no response, then DMed on 10/1. The owner, Dana, replied on 10/10 asking what we charge for a 60-second promo for their new location opening in November. Odds are high: the decision-maker described a specific need 3 days ago. The goal is to answer her pricing question and book a call before the November opening; reference our med spa work.
must_get_right: Uses what the reply says (60-second promo, new location opening in November, asked about price)
Last activity is the reply on 10/10, not the DM we sent on 10/1
Odds: high (decision-maker described a specific need 3 days ago)
Goal is to answer the pricing question / book a call before the November opening
Doesn't treat the earlier unanswered email as a reason for low odds

touchpoints.summary: Intro email with our med spa reel
Short DM complimenting their new lash bar post, linked our reel
touchpoints.responseText: Hi! Thanks so much. We're actually opening a second location in Brandon in November and have been thinking about video for it. What do you charge for something like a 60 second promo?
